title: Upholsterers
description: Make, repair, or replace upholstery for household furniture or transportation vehicles.

tasks.text: Fit, install, and secure material on frames, using hand tools, power tools, glue, cement, or staples.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.
Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Measure and cut new covering materials, using patterns and measuring and cutting instruments, following sketches and design specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Build furniture up with loose fiber stuffing, cotton, felt, or foam padding to form smooth, rounded surfaces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sewing and assembling textiles needs fine dexterity

tasks.text: Make, restore, or create custom upholstered furniture, using hand tools and knowledge of fabrics and upholstery methods.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on upholstery and furniture repair in unstructured materials

tasks.text: Read work orders, and apply knowledge and experience with materials to determine types and amounts of materials required to cover workpieces.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.

tasks.text: Examine furniture frames, upholstery, springs, and webbing to locate defects.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Property condition assessment requires physical presence

dwas.name: Examine condition of property or products.

tasks.text: Adjust or replace webbing, padding, or springs, and secure them in place.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on upholstery and furniture repair in unstructured materials

tasks.text: Sew rips or tears in material, or create tufting, using needles and thread.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sewing clothing requires fine manual dexterity

tasks.text: Remove covering, webbing, padding, or defective springs from workpieces, using hand tools such as hammers and tack pullers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on upholstery and furniture repair in unstructured materials

tasks.text: Attach fasteners, grommets, buttons, buckles, ornamental trim, and other accessories to covers or frames, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Attaching accessories requires manual fitting

dwas.name: Attach decorative or functional accessories to products.

tasks.text: Repair furniture frames and refinish exposed wood.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on upholstery and furniture repair in unstructured materials

dwas.name: Shape surfaces or edges of wood workpieces.

tasks.text: Interweave and fasten strips of webbing to the backs and undersides of furniture, using small hand tools and fasteners.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on upholstery and furniture repair in unstructured materials

tasks.text: Draw cutting lines on material following patterns, templates, sketches, or blueprints, using chalk, pencils, paint, or other methods.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Stretch webbing and fabric, using webbing stretchers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Adjusting fabric is tactile manual work

dwas.name: Adjust fabrics or other materials during garment production.

tasks.text: Operate sewing machines or sew upholstery by hand to seam cushions and join various sections of covering material.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating sewing equipment is manual machine work

tasks.text: Design upholstery cover patterns and cutting plans, based on sketches, customer descriptions, or blueprints.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Generates template designs; aesthetic fit needs human review

tasks.text: Maintain records of time required to perform each job.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Discuss upholstery fabrics, colors, and styles with customers, and provide cost estimates.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cost estimation from inputs; human validates

dwas.name: Estimate costs of products, services, or materials.
Confer with customers or designers to determine order specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Pick up and deliver furniture.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of furniture in varied spaces

tasks.text: Attach bindings or apply solutions to edges of cut material to prevent raveling.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical fabric/material preparation

dwas.name: Prepare fabrics or materials for processing or production.

tasks.text: Collaborate with interior designers to decorate rooms and coordinate furnishing fabrics.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Colleague information exchange is relational, contextual

dwas.name: Exchange information with colleagues.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Make, repair, or replace automobile upholstery and convertible and vinyl tops, using knowledge of fabric and upholstery methods.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on upholstery and furniture repair in unstructured materials
